'''Garrett Larson''' (GEMP handle '''deadbody''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> is a member of the [[Killer Bees]].<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> He finished '''4th''' in [[2025 Retro League Event 2|Event 2 of the 2025 Retro League]].<ref name="p1440434" /> Larson also finished '''#15''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] and '''#40''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 39).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020233611/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb].
